highlights.title: GTA 6 Data Reveals Only 40% of Players Have Cleared Chapter 2
highlights.summary: If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6, here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.
body: According to PSNProfiles, only 66.22% of Grand Theft Auto 6 players on PlayStation 5 have earned the trophy for completing Chapter 1, which takes place in the Leonida Keys. The numbers on Xbox are similar, with 56% of players having beaten that part of the game, according to TrueAchievements. This completion percentage feels particularly significant because the first chapter of the game is a big departure from classic GTA, with Jason living out a relatively low-key existence interrupted by the occasional shootout with backwoods drug dealers. Still, it seems a solid chunk of players are more than happy fishing with Cal for now.

Meanwhile, only 40.55% of players have cleared Chapter 2 on PS5, and 31% on Xbox. Again, considering that Chapter 3 is arguably where the game becomes more of a traditional Grand Theft Auto entry, as you officially enter Vice City, it’s a bit of a surprise that the numbers are so low, even if it takes close to 20 hours to get there.

highlights.title: Francis Lawrence Signed On for One ‘Hunger Games’ Movie. Five Films Later, He’s the Keeper of Panem
highlights.summary: The 'Sunrise on the Reaping' director looks back on the pressure of taking over a franchise, his decade-long collaboration with Suzanne Collins, why the series endures, and where things stand on ‘Constantine 2’ and 'Red Rising.'
body: The morning after the New York premiere of The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, Francis Lawrence is still taking in the view from the night before.

“Last night at the premiere, for the first time, we had three generations of cast,” Lawrence tells The Hollywood Reporter of the Nov. 16 event. “There’s something really special about the time we’ve all spent together and the quality of people I’ve gotten to work with.”

Lawrence has been a constant across all of them. Since taking over from director Gary Ross with 2013’s Catching Fire, he has directed every Hunger Games film that followed, working alongside producer Nina Jacobson to turn Suzanne Collins’ dystopian saga following teenagers forced into fatal combat into one of Hollywood’s most dependable franchises. The original four films grossed roughly $2.98 billion worldwide, and Collins’ five books have sold more than 100 million copies globally, growing into one of the most successful young adult publishing franchises in history.

Still, the scale didn’t fully hit him until the final Mockingjay films. Around the release of the films, The Hunger Games: The Exhibition opened to fans, and Lawrence walked through it with his stars.

highlights.title: Jensen Huang Apologizes to Nvidia Employees in First All-Hands Since His Return
highlights.summary: The reinstated Nvidia CEO acknowledged violating the company’s code of conduct and said he had made some “very serious personal mistakes.”
body: “This is going to be the hardest company meeting I’ve ever done, and the second hardest meeting I have ever done,” Huang said, according to remarks reviewed by WIRED. “The hardest meeting I’ve ever done was with my wife.”

The CEO emphasized that Nvidia’s code of conduct, much of which he said he wrote himself, still governs how employees are expected to treat one another and is intended to “create an environment that’s safe for people.”

Huang told employees that violations of the code would not be tolerated. But that “does not mean, the moment you violate a code of conduct, we walk you out the door,” he said. “Facts, circumstances, a lot of assessments” would factor in.

Huang also pushed back against the notion that he had received preferential treatment because of his status in Silicon Valley. “There are rumors on the internet that apparently I’m a tech bro, and therefore I’m back,” Huang said. He rejected the suggestion that he was above the law or Nvidia’s code of conduct.

highlights.title: iRestore Elite Laser Hair Growth System Review: Husband-Approved
highlights.summary: Here’s how his scalp fared after several months of using the iRestore Elite Laser Hair Growth System.
body: Aging is hard. It’s jarring when the luscious, flowing locks of your youth start to disappear before your very eyes. But it can’t be helped—or can it? Red light therapy has been used to treat inflammation, pain relief, and wrinkles, and it's now being applied to hair regrowth. It’s also a much more accessible option than flying to Istanbul for a full-on hair transplant.

iRestore’s Elite red light therapy cap appeared on my radar because of my own hair woes, including scalp irritation and eczema. My hope was that it could help with cell regeneration and kill off the bacteria causing flares.

However, an even better test subject stood right before me—my husband, who is dealing with a rapidly receding hairline. He’s always excited to help with mattress and sleep product testing, so I roped him into testing this hair-growth helmet—for science, of course. To help understand said science, I also spoke with Zakia Rahman, MD, FAAD. Rahman is a clinical professor of dermatology at Stanford University School of Medicine, and a trailblazer in red light therapy research.

highlights.title: Tidal will start banning AI-generated music next month
highlights.summary: Tidal is officially banning AI-generated music on December 9th. As a result of this change, Tidal will delete around 29 million AI-generated songs and reject an estimated 80,000 to 85,000 tracks per day, according to Tidal music lead Robert Andersen.
body: The music streaming platform estimates that it will delete 29 million songs as a result of the AI ban.

The move comes just months after Tidal began labeling and demonetizing tracks identified as 100 percent AI-generated. In a post on X, Andersen says Tidal needed to take a more “drastic” measure, as AI music made up 43 percent of the tracks distributed to the platform in the last 90 days. “We believe this will resonate with both artists and listeners alike, as 96% of all AI-generated songs receive zero plays at all,” Andersen adds.

Bandcamp similarly banned AI music earlier this year, while other music streaming platforms attempt to address a flood of AI songs by applying new labels or removing them from user algorithms. Spotify recently announced that it removed 50 million AI slop and spam tracks from recommendations over the past year, and also launched new “AI persona” badges for artists that use an AI identity. YouTube has rolled out AI music labels as well, while Apple Music is planning to launch AI labels this year. Meanwhile, Deezer is giving users the option to filter out AI music.

highlights.summary: Ireland's stand-in captain Dan Sheehan will be banned for two games after a croc-roll tackle against South Africa and will play no part against Australia on Friday night.
body: The Leinster forward was shown a yellow card by referee Christophe Ridley in the 72nd minute of Ireland's 20-17 victory over the Springboks in Dublin on Saturday.

That was later upgraded to a red card by the foul play review officer (FPRO) on the basis of World Rugby's Law 9.20d that "a player may remove the jackler from the tackle area by pushing/driving them backwards (including by grabbing the knee/leg), but must not roll, pull or twist an opponent".
The 28-year-old faced a disciplinary hearing on Monday evening where the panel found that the incident was a "low-entry point" offence and merited a two-week ban.

Sheehan will miss Friday's Nations Championship finals weekend fixture against Australia in Twickenham (20:10 GMT) and Leinster's game against Ospreys in the United Rugby Championship (URC) on 4 December.

body: The movie is being written by James Morosini, an actor and filmmaker who previously wrote, directed, and starred in the 2022 comedy I Love My Dad. Melissa Goodall and Sajan Algiri from The Arena are overseeing the adaptation.

Beyond Metal Slug, The Arena is currently working on several other adaptations of SNK properties. The studio is producing a Fatal Fury movie written by David S. Goyer ( Man of Steel, Foundation, The Dark Knight trilogy) and a Samurai Shodown film, with Laeta Laogridis ( Altered Carbon, Alita: Battle Angel, Shutter Island ) handling the screenplay. The studio is also backing an Art of Fighting webtoon by digital creator Brandon Chen.

In 2022, the EGDC, owned by the Mohammed bin Salman Foundation, acquired a 96.18% stake in SNK. As for the studio producing the new Metal Slug film, The Arena is owned by MBC Group, a Saudi media conglomerate, and the Misk Foundation, also known as the Mohammed bin Salman Foundation.

highlights.title: Jensen Huang deepfakes are the hot new AI slop
highlights.summary: Jensen Huang is partying it up in Ibiza. In a video with nearly 6 million views on Instagram, the former CEO of Nvidia is dancing in a crowded club, champagne glass in hand, still wearing his signature black leather jacket.
body: Influencers are chasing viral success with the saga — and tech stack — of Nvidia’s CEO.

Unlike deepfake pornography or election disinformation, these AI videos aren’t necessarily intended to harm or mislead people. They’re memes making fun of Huang’s cheating scandal and its global implications, created with AI technology that in many cases relies heavily on Nvidia’s tech stack: video diffusion models running on the Nvidia GPUs that power much of the modern generative AI industry. “It’s ironic that without Nvidia generating millions of these AI memes... would not be possible,” reads one of the top comments on the Ibiza deepfake. “In some sense, Jensen is making Nvidia richer by his own scandal.” The comment was punctuated by multiple cry-laughing emoji.

highlights.title: Senegal reinstated as Afcon 2025 winners - 10 months after tournament
highlights.summary: Ten months after the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final, Senegal are reinstated as champions following a ruling by the Court of Arbitration for Sport.
body: The court's award overturns a previous decision which had stripped the West Africans of the title they won on the pitch during a chaotic final against host nation Morocco in January.

With the game goalless, Senegal left the field of play in second-half stoppage time in protest at a penalty awarded against them. The match in Rabat was delayed by over 15 minutes before Morocco's Brahim Diaz had his spot-kick saved.
Senegal then triumphed 1-0 after extra time, with Pape Gueye scoring the winner.

That result was overturned almost two months later when a Confederation of African Football (Caf) appeals board decreed the Teranga Lions had breached competition regulations by leaving the field of play after the penalty was awarded.

The new Hall of Fame category will appear when voting opens, and will let players choose their favourite from Steam's previous Game of the Year winners to crown the best game of the past decade.
Most categories are only open to games released on Steam since last year's Autumn Sale.

The exception is the Labo(u)r of Love award, which goes to older games that developers are still supporting with new content. Previous Labo(u)r of Love winners, including Warframe, Grand Theft Auto 5, Cyberpunk 2077, and Baldur's Gate 3, can't be nominated again.

highlights.title: How Netflix and the NFL Hope to Establish New Thanksgiving Eve Tradition With Game and U2 Half-Time Show: ‘We Want to Create Those Global Water Cooler Moments’
highlights.summary: Thanksgiving Day has sported NFL games since the league’s inception in 1920, and now Turkey Day tussles on the gridiron are supercharged for the streaming future. On Nov. 25, Netflix and the NFL would like football fans to join them for a new holiday tradition: the Thanksgiving Eve game.
body: “As the NFL opened up more inventory and started talking to us about [possibly adding] more games, [Thanksgiving Eve] is one that they mentioned and immediately it felt like the perfect fit,” says Spitzer, who spoke with Variety while sporting a New England Patriots cap.

Onnie Bose, the NFL’s VP of broadcasting, echoes that sentiment. The league has learned “over the last few years that when family and friends are together, they gravitate toward watching our games,” Bose says. “Our Thanksgiving viewership has always been strong. I think it’s exploded. We hit 57 million viewers with the Kansas City-Dallas game last year.”

There is precedent for staking out new NFL-watching traditions, as the league has worked closely with Amazon Prime Video over the last few years to successfully establish the Black Friday game on the day after Thanksgiving.

“We’ve been building Black Friday with Amazon over the last few years. So Thanksgiving is a clear natural weekend where people are together,” Bose says. “They’re watching football. We’ve seen that on Christmas also in the last few years. We just looked at it as an opportunity to do something new.”

highlights.title: Amazon drone crashes on garage after delivering shampoo, draws FAA probe
highlights.summary: An Amazon delivery drone that clipped a fiber-optic line before crashing onto a garage roof is now the subject of an investigation by the US Federal Aviation Administration.
body: The November 20 incident began with Jim Brennan and his wife, residents of Huntington Woods, Michigan, placing an order for shampoo and being surprised by a notification about the package arriving by drone within seven minutes, according to WXYZ 7 News Detroit. After the drone dropped the package into Brennan’s backyard, it lost a propeller when it caught on fiber-optic cable and floundered sideways before getting pinned between the neighbor’s garage roof and some power lines.
“Like a sick bird, it tried to go up, it tried to get out of here,” Brennan told WXYZ 7.

Amazon Prime Air currently operates a fleet of battery-powered MK30 drones that can deliver packages weighing up to five pounds and have onboard sense-and-avoid technology to avoid obstacles. However, the drone clearly failed to avoid the thin fiber-optic cable in this case—so hopefully the FAA investigation would take that into account along with Amazon delivery drone procedures.

The FAA preliminary accident and incident notification briefly describes the incident as “UAS struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff.” That notice was posted on November 23.

highlights.title: WoW: Forever’s Best Buffs Now Work As Intended
highlights.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever players will now be able to get even more benefit from the game's strongest buffs, as developer Blizzard's latest hotfix has made World Buffs persist across loading screens as intended.
body: World Buffs are powerful stat-boosting effects granted to players in a particular area for certain events. The most common World Buff players see is Warchief's Blessing on the Horde and the new Might of Stormwind for the Alliance, which are granted to all players in Orgrimmar, Stormwind, and their surrounding low-level zones when players on their respective faction turn in a specific high-level quest.

Now that players are reaching endgame and turning in the required quest, these buffs are popping off constantly. They grant a whopping 300 hit points, 15% melee haste, and 10 mana regen per five seconds for one hour. At lower levels, those are some serious stats, particularly the 300 HP.

Unfortunately, players haven't been able to take full advantage of the buffs, as a bug was causing them to be lost when hitting a loading screen. That meant any time a group stepped into a dungeon or took a boat or zeppelin to a new location, their World Buffs would be removed.

highlights.title: Raising the stakes for enterprise networks with AI modernization
highlights.summary: Enterprise networks are under severe strain. As companies rush to deploy artificial intelligence, the technology is quickly becoming the biggest source of demand on the network. Now, agentic AI is adding to the load.
body: As AI inference shifts from hyperscale training clouds—the huge centralized data centers where raw AI models ingest vast datasets and learn—to real-time, latency-sensitive applications, the need for on-premises or near-premises infrastructure grows. As a result, the gap between enterprise networks that are ready to support AI and those that are not is widening. As few as half of enterprises believe their current networks can handle AI’s bandwidth and latency demands, according to a recent study.
This report explores how treating network modernization as an on-going strategy rather than a one-off project can help organizations adapt in the face of disruption and uncertainty.

AI may force companies to shift from a cloud-first approach to routing workloads. Training AI requires server-to-server data center architectures, while inference calls for low-latency connectivity close to users. Enterprises may need to fundamentally reconsider their network architecture to meet these requirements.

highlights.summary: Referees’ chief Howard Webb admitted it was a “quick check” by VAR for Arsenal defender Jurrien Timber’s unpunished shirt-pull on Liverpool striker Alexander Isak in the Gunners’ win at Anfield.
body: Webb also said Isak's lack of a "natural reaction" to Timber's shirt pull on him was a factor in the decision not to award a penalty after the striker did not go down or protest the decision.
Earlier this month, the Premier League's Key Match Incidents Panel ruled Liverpool should have been awarded a penalty for Timber's shirt tug on Isak inside the box at a cross.
Upon a review of the incident on Match Officials Mic'd Up, it was revealed that VAR Stuart Attwell spotted the shirt-pull offence but decided it was "all fine" 11 seconds later.

After declaring it was "all fine", referee Andy Madley and the assistant referee asked for clarification, which Attwell immediately responded to with "all fine", meaning the total check took only 18 seconds.

highlights.title: Catastrophic 'GTA 6' Leak Officially Kickstarts PC Port Race
highlights.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 ' s official release seemed like the end for apparent hacker Cyberleek, who raised millions of dollars in cryptocurrency by sharing unauthorized video of the open-world game ahead of launch.
body: Those following along might recall Cyberleek as the hacker who spent weeks provoking Rockstar Games. In addition to supplying the internet with leaked footage of the unfinished version of the game, Cyberleek also critiqued Rockstar and parent company Take-Two Interactive's business practices. The leaker claimed they objected to GTA 6 's digital-only release as well as its pre-order bonuses. Cyberleek encouraged Rockstar and Take-Two to change course by dangling the possibility of sharing the files they were using to play the game to the public.

This suggestion was particularly shocking since Rockstar has not made the game available outside of console platforms. The game also doesn't exist on a disc, meaning that players don't have access to the game files. Without such data, players can't peek under the hood of the game — and they definitely could not tinker with it in unintended ways, like forcing the characters to appear without clothes in the overworld.

highlights.title: Kevin Kline Reunites With Meryl Streep in ‘The Corrections’ Series at Netflix
highlights.summary: Kevin Kline will star opposite Meryl Streep in the Netflix limited series adaptation of “The Corrections,” Variety has learned. Based on the novel of the same name by Jonathan Franzen, the series was originally announced with Streep attached back in April.
body: Kline will star as Alfred Lambert, who is described as “a once-powerful patriarch who is battling the afflictions of aging. A man of strict principles and old-fashioned decorum, Alfred must come to terms with his three very modern children—a daughter whose secrets he can no longer protect, an older son who has displaced him as the authority in the family, and a wayward son whose forgiveness he yearns for.”

The casting marks the latest collaboration between Kline and Streep. The two most famously worked together in the hit 1982 drama “Sophie’s Choice,” which was Kline’s feature debut and for which Streep earned her second Academy Award. Kline and Streep have also appeared onscreen together in the films “A Prairie Home Companion” and “Ricki and the Flash.”
